forum.title: Performance of STM32N6
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@NMO,

In ST Model Zoo, you will find a lot of model architectures for different use cases.

For each one, you should find performance metrics.

For example, for the Yolov8n, look at the differents arrays on the page:

[stm32ai-modelzoo/object\_detection/yolov8n at main · STMicroelectronics/stm32ai-modelzoo](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32ai-modelzoo/tree/main/object_detection/yolov8n)

We are working on improving the browsing of models.

Also you have the ST Developper cloud where you can benchmark your models on a real N6DK board (and others): [ST Edge AI Developer Cloud - STMicroelectronics - STM32 AI](https://stm32ai.st.com/st-edge-ai-developer-cloud/)

Have a good day,

Julian
forum.content_text: Hello, I am working on a visual inertial odometry system. It basically contains a camera, a vision processing unit and an IMU. For vision processing part I was thinking of the STM32N6. Can you elaborate on the performance of the ST Neural-ART processsor? Can you elaborate on the inference time? How many images per second can it process?
